Name: batch_size_grokking
Title: Batch Size Grokking: Assessing the impact of the training batchsize on the grokking phenomenon
Experiment: Modify the experiments to dynamically adjust the batch size during training, starting with a small batch size and gradually increasing it. This could potentially lead to faster generalization on the validation set.

Name: progressive_dataset_reveal
Title: Progressive Dataset Reveal: Curriculum Learning to Probe Grokking Dynamics
Experiment: Implement CurriculumDataset(dataset, init_frac=0.05) that stores dataset.train_pairs. It keeps active_pairs, initially a random subset of size int(init_frac*len(train_pairs)). Override fetch_train_example() to sample from active_pairs. Add grow(factor, max_size) to expand active_pairs. In run(), add arg schedule_type in ['static','linear','exp','full']. Every GROW_STEP (e.g. 500 updates) call grow(): static does nothing, linear adds +delta examples, exp multiplies active size by 2, full starts with all pairs. Log: active_size, step_val_acc_99, final metrics. Compare across schedules for each task and seed, focusing on time-to-grokking and data revealed when grokking occurs.

Name: wd_phase_transition
Title: Weight-Decay Phase Transition: Mapping Grokking Dynamics across Magnitude and Onset
Experiment: Add WeightDecayScheduler that at each step sets optimizer.param_groups[0]['weight_decay'] to (0 if step < onset_step else target_wd). In run(), loop over wd_targets=[0,1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,0.1,0.5] and onset_steps=[0,1000,3000,5000]. Keep other hyper-params fixed. Log: current weight_decay, parameter L2 norm, step_train_acc_99, step_val_acc_99, grokking_time = step_val_acc_99 − step_train_acc_99 (if positive). Aggregate per task into heat-maps of grokking_time and final accuracy versus (wd,onset).
